newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Netanyahu, Arafat to attend Swiss forum-officials.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu, Arafat to attend Swiss forum-officials.

text.p: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat will both attend the World Economic Forum in Swiss resort of Davos at the end of next week, Forum officials said on Tuesday.

Forum founder Klaus Schwab told reporters that Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak would also be there and it was hoped all three would be together on the platform for a discussion on the Middle East on Sunday February 2.
Officials of the Geneva-based Forum said final arrangements for the appearance of the three had not yet been completed. But they would be staying in Davos for between 36 and 48 hours.
"We hope they will agree to sit together on Sunday at a plenary session and answer questions," said one.

Schwab said he was not aiming to arrange talks between the three or any combination of them. "At the Forum, we leave it to the people involved to organise such meetings if they wish," he told a news conference.
Three years ago, Arafat and then Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin held talks in Davos during the annual Forum which helped clear the way for a Middle East peace accord.
